violations.description: Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Certified food manager certification has expired. Facility must have a certified food manager.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Wiping cloth bucket with sanitizing solution found at 0ppm, chlorine. Wiping cloths should be stored in a sanitizing solution of at least 100ppm, chlorine.

Person in charge. — --Certified food service manager had an expired certificate or is no longer associated with this establishment. Manager’s food safety certification expired in May. Facility should have a certified food manager.
Available, knowledgeable, certified manager (4 pts deducted)
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
